central_directory_contract: Only if entire single-disk non-ZIP64 central directory is contained in acquired tail, <=512 entries, exact lengths/counts/end, no duplicate/traversal/control-character/link/special/encrypted paths. Declared CRC is not verification.
scope: Fresh fixed artifact metadata, then exactly one official gh GET /zip with Range and --include. No manual redirect URL; no subsequent member ranges.
stdout_contract: Only typed safe headers, body of a precisely identified 206 response, counts/digests of consumed stdout/header/stderr bytes. Unrecognized framing is HOLD, no header/body inference.
unsupported_status_policy: A non-206 observed response immediately terminates only the owned read-only request. No body from a 200 response is retained. gh streaming/Range compatibility remains to be observed.
